svg.text: Each dot is one interval against the next. A metronome would be a single point; the healthy heart is a comet along the dashed identity line: short-term, beat-to-beat changes
(SD1, orange, = RMSSD/√2, the vagal brake) are narrower than slow changes (SD2, green). Ectopic beats throw dots far off the line (short-then-long, long-then-short), which is why
HRV is computed from NN intervals only. SD1 and SD2 are from NN → NN pairs.
